# Build a Brainrot

> Free web app where kids aged 7+ make their own silly "brainrot" meme characters: pick a character (sharks, cats, bananas and more), add colours, accessories, stickers and sounds, then share a link or download an image. No sign-up, no email, no chat, no ads.

## Pages

- [Home](https://buildabrainrot.com/): what it is and how it works in four steps
- [Character builder](https://buildabrainrot.com/character-builder): make a character
- [For parents](https://buildabrainrot.com/parents): safety features, what data is and isn't collected
- [Privacy](https://buildabrainrot.com/privacy): what data the site uses, browser storage, short links and your rights
